prompt: A modal checkout form looks correct in a screenshot, but keyboard focus stays behind it and an error message is not announced. The product targets WCAG 2.2 AA. Produce an audit plan and finding; do not claim conformance from the screenshot.
rubric: Names keyboard focus placement, containment, Escape and restoration plus programmatic error association.
States browser/assistive-technology matrix and distinguishes observed from untested.
Provides repeatable finding and recheck without claiming full conformance.
